purpose: Independent source-method review for separately measuring reported motives and correspondence to scoped observations; this is not an all-Arabic completeness certificate.
reviewer_role: Research author independent of runtime implementation and reference answers

repository_primary_sources.title: الشخصية الإسلامية، الجزء الثالث: الوضع والحقيقة والمجاز والقرائن
repository_primary_sources.read_scope: Selected retained passages, not the entire original book
interpretation: The selected passage p401 defines whole/part/mental-implication indications; mental implication need not be an implication in external reality. The phrase that necessity is a condition rather than a cause concerns linguistic indication; it does not license any unobserved physical fact.

repository_primary_sources.title: الشخصية الإسلامية، الجزء الأول
repository_primary_sources.read_scope: Selected retained passages, not the entire original book
interpretation: The s1.words-concepts-reality passage separates understanding a verbal meaning from whether that meaning exists in external reality. Attribution to this author is recorded without treating the philosophical account as independently established empirical science.

repository_primary_sources.title: التفكير
repository_primary_sources.read_scope: Selected retained passages, not the entire original book
interpretation: The rational-method passage distinguishes prior information from pre-existing opinions and explicitly admits possible error in judgments about the nature and attributes of a thing. The experimental-method passage treats experimental conclusions as revisable.

external_primary_sources.title: Semantic Sensor Network Ontology
external_primary_sources.summary: An observation relates a feature, observed property, procedure, result and observer. The time the result applies to the feature differs from the time the result was produced. Sensors may be physical, human or software; those modes must be distinguished rather than pooled as equivalent physical evidence.
external_primary_sources.design_consequence: Bind feature identity, property, procedure, phenomenon time and result time; record digital, physical, reported or simulated acquisition explicitly.

external_primary_sources.title: Guide to the expression of uncertainty in measurement — Part 1: Introduction
external_primary_sources.publisher: Joint Committee for Guides in Metrology
external_primary_sources.summary: Measurement results include estimates and uncertainty information needed for use. Evaluation depends on knowledge of the measurand and method; meaningful uncertainty sources and dependencies must not be omitted. A program accepting a numeric field does not independently establish the measurand or measurement accuracy.
external_primary_sources.design_consequence: Physical comparisons require the declared unit, measurand, uncertainty model and decision rule; exact published-value comparison has a narrower scope than physical truth.

external_primary_sources.title: FEVER: a Large-scale Dataset for Fact Extraction and VERification
external_primary_sources.summary: Claims are verified against textual evidence and assigned supported, refuted or not-enough-information labels. Annotators did not know the source sentence used to construct each claim. The task is evidence-relative verification, not proof of external reality.
external_primary_sources.design_consequence: Use independent reference annotation and evidence-required scoring, with unresolved evidence distinct from refutation; report this separately from observations.

external_primary_sources.title: GeoJSON Summary Format
external_primary_sources.summary: The agency format records event identity and location, event and update times, magnitude and magnitude type, and source/review information. Fields supply a practical external observational reference but do not grant a Lean checker authority to assert absolute physical truth.
external_primary_sources.design_consequence: A frozen official response can support a small observation-relative pilot; preserve original bytes and acquisition metadata before interpreting Arabic claims.

steps: Independently select a finite workspace artifact and declared property such as byte size or byte content.
Observe using a recorded procedure, with filesystem object identity, acquisition time and revision digest.
Seal the observation before an independent author writes claim interpretations and expected judgments.
Compare Arabic claim referent, property, value, units, context and polarity; treat scope mismatch or missing evidence as unresolved.
Repeat observations or change the object to demonstrate revision sensitivity; freeze each acquisition separately.
feasible_independent_protocols.establishes: A bounded comparison to a local digital observation at a stated revision; not physical sensing, hidden motive, or Arabic-wide semantic completeness.
feasible_independent_protocols.simulation_policy: Real measurements of actual artifact bytes are digital observations. Invented observation rows remain SIMULATION or AUTHORED_FIXTURE and must not enter an empirical denominator.

steps: Acquire and seal raw official JSON plus URL, fetch time, SHA-256 and agency update field.
Use typed Arabic claims with event identity, phenomenon time, property, magnitude type or unit, polarity and evidence source.
Independently author reference answers; include different event, wrong time, revision mismatch, negative claim, missing value and deliberately excessive precision.
Compare to the reported observation, preserving unknown uncertainty. Do not infer causation or event absence from proximity or missing rows.
feasible_independent_protocols.establishes: Correspondence to a scoped agency observation/report; instrument calibration and the absolute external fact are outside the checker.
feasible_independent_protocols.capture_status: Raw HTTP response acquired; no benchmark outcome is asserted by source review.

reported_motive.target: What motive a particular speaker explicitly reports in a specific utterance and context.
reported_motive.success: Correct source-bound attribution and stance, with complete required evidence; mere plausible motive is not success.
reported_motive.does_not_establish: The speaker actually had that motive, acted on it, or is generally driven by an instinct.

latent_motive.target: Actual unobserved motive of a person.
latent_motive.countermodel: Two possible states may share the same observable report but differ in latent motive. A function of that report alone must return the same output and cannot identify both states correctly.
latent_motive.possible_future_protocol: Operationally define a specific target, collect consented independent observations or interventions, preregister annotation and validation criteria, and report uncertainty. No generic part-of-speech mapping licenses inference.

observation_correspondence.target: Agreement of a claim with an independently acquired, scoped observation under a declared comparison procedure.
observation_correspondence.does_not_establish: Unqualified truth of all world claims, validity of uncalibrated sensors, or completeness of all possible readings.

benchmark_contract.fixed_denominator: Predeclare all reference cases; do not remove cases because the runtime returns unknown, missing reading, or unsupported grammar.
separate_metrics: parse/readings recall against independent candidate sets
reported-motive extraction accuracy on eligible source-attested cases
observation correspondence accuracy on eligible independently acquired observations
anti_inflation: Do not count correct refusal to infer a hidden motive as successful motive identification.
Do not promote a text quote or caller Boolean into an independent observation.
Do not pool authored fixtures, simulated facts and real acquired observations.
Do not score a selected reading as exhaustive when alternatives remain.
Do not count passing tests or hash verification as a theorem about all Arabic.
benchmark_contract.independence: Reference authors must not copy runtime labels; freeze answers before running the checker. Shared underlying source must be recorded even when annotators differ.

article_claim_reviews.reason: Grammatical nominal status and semantic event/state type are separate axes. A nominal clause may have an eventive verbal predicate.

article_claim_reviews.claim: Every verb implies free human volition.
article_claim_reviews.reason: A verb can describe an involuntary event or a nonhuman participant. Grammar alone does not identify intention.

examples: وقع أ قبل ب، ولا توجد في النموذج علاقة سببية بينهما
article_claim_reviews.reason: A model with ordered events and an empty causal relation satisfies temporal order without causation.

article_claim_reviews.claim: A closed root cycle proves its semantic claims and all-Arabic completeness.
article_claim_reviews.reason: A finite cyclic graph can be explored with a visited set, but reachability does not authenticate labels or ground meanings. Acyclicity and the presence of a nontrivial cycle are distinct properties; an SCC condensation can be acyclic without its original graph being acyclic.

article_claim_reviews.claim: A Boolean empirical-reality flag or mandatory JSON proof string establishes a true world fact.
article_claim_reviews.reason: Validation checks representation constraints; imported labels and proof prose need independent admissibility and checked claims.

limits: No real human motive dataset was collected or annotated in this review.
No claims of all-Arabic, all-world, metaphysical or psychological completeness are made.
Source passage hashes verify byte correspondence only, not the truth or attribution of the entire original book.
The current philosophical sources are treated as attributed accounts; disagreement with an engineering inference is not a rejection of the religious text or author.
Benchmark counters and future finite-model soundness must state their configured universe and inference rules.
